- **Byzantine Mosaic** (`lumenary:byzantine-mosaic`, models this process): Mosaic setters pushed each small cube into wet plaster at a slight angle, so the surface glitters as the viewer moves, and they laid the cubes in rows that follow the shapes, a flow called andamento. Gold tesserae, made by sealing a leaf of gold between layers… Model: `processes/models/lumenary/byzantine-mosaic.json`; theory: `treatments/lumenary/theory/11-world.md`.
